This Go repository may contain functions that implement the same behavior in more than one place, even when their names, packages, and implementations differ.

Find function pairs that are genuine consolidation candidates. For each pair you conclude is a real duplicate, report one line:

  <path>::<FuncName>  <->  <path>::<FuncName>  — one-sentence reason

Only report pairs you actually believe implement the same behavior. Do not edit any code.
